description: Filter transactions above $10,000 from US within 30 days
example_query: FROM cortex-transactions | WHERE amount > ?threshold AND origin_country == ?country | WHERE DATE_DIFF('day', transaction_date, NOW()) <= ?days | LIMIT 100

description: Count flagged transactions by risk tier
example_query: FROM cortex-transactions | WHERE is_flagged == true | STATS count = COUNT(*), total = SUM(amount) BY risk_tier | SORT count DESC
